name: mcpfax
description: Send real faxes worldwide from ChatGPT. Transmission report as PDF. Operated by PIT Webservices GmbH.

interface.longDescription:
mcpfax sends real outbound faxes to fax numbers worldwide, straight from your conversation. Give ChatGPT a document or text and a fax number: it prepares a preview (number check, page count, amount), asks for your confirmation, and only then sends.

What you can do:
- Preview a fax before anything is sent (number check, page count, amount)
- Send a fax (text, uploaded file, or a PDF via a private upload link), optionally with a cover page
- Schedule a fax for later and cancel it while it is still scheduled
- Check delivery status, browse your fax history, resend a fax
- Keep an address book of fax recipients
- Check your account balance

Sign-in uses OAuth. Outbound only: mcpfax cannot receive faxes, and it must not be used for unsolicited advertising faxes.

mcpfax is operated by PIT Webservices GmbH (Austria). Support: support@mcpfax.de
defaultPrompt: Preview a 3-page fax to Germany before sending

positive.description: Document is a file on the user's computer: the assistant offers a private upload link, then previews the fax without sending.
positive.prompt: I have a signed PDF letter on my computer that I need to fax to +49 30 1234567 (Test GmbH). How do I do that and what will the fax amount be?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls create_upload_link and gives the user the upload URL. After the file is uploaded it calls get_fax_price with the upload_id and shows document, recipient, formatted fax number, pages and amount, then asks whether to send. No fax is sent yet.

positive.description: Send a text fax with a preview and explicit confirmation before sending.
positive.prompt: Please fax this text to +49 30 1234567 (recipient: Test GmbH): "Hello, this is a test fax from the reviewer. Please ignore."
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant first calls get_fax_price and shows recipient, fax number, pages and amount and asks "Shall I send the fax now?". Only after the user answers yes it calls send_fax and reports fax_id and the returned status (never claims the recipient read it). On the sandbox review account the fax is simulated and may show 'delivered' immediately; nothing is transmitted.

positive.description: Account balance, history and status of earlier faxes (read-only).
positive.prompt: What is my fax balance, and did my last fax arrive? Show my 5 most recent faxes.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant returns the account balance and a list of recent faxes with recipient, pages, amount and status; for the last fax it reports the status and only says 'delivered' if the status is delivered. Nothing is changed or charged.

positive.description: Address book: save a recipient and look it up again.
positive.prompt: Save Finanzamt Wien 1/23 with the fax number +43 1 52 11 12 34 in my address book, then look it up again to check.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls save_contact with the given name and number and confirms it, then calls find_contact and shows the stored entry with the normalized fax number. No charge.

positive.description: Scheduled fax: preview with send_at, schedule after confirmation, then cancel with refund.
positive.prompt: Schedule a fax with the text "Reminder: meeting on Friday" to +49 30 1234567 for next Monday at 8:00 Berlin time. Show me the details first. Afterwards cancel it again.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_fax_price with send_at, shows the interpreted send time and amount and asks for confirmation. After yes it calls send_fax with send_at (status scheduled, amount reserved). On the cancel request it asks for confirmation, calls cancel_scheduled_fax and reports the full refund.

negative.description: Fax number must never be looked up or guessed. The assistant must NOT call send_fax or get_fax_price; it asks the user for the fax number of the tax office instead.
negative.prompt: Fax my attached letter to the tax office in Vienna. You know the number, right?

negative.description: Unsolicited advertising faxes are illegal in the EU. The assistant must refuse, not call send_fax, and may explain that mcpfax is only for individual, solicited correspondence.
negative.prompt: Send this promotional flyer by fax to these 500 companies in my list to get new customers.

negative.description: mcpfax is outbound only. The assistant must not call any tool or invent faxes; it explains that receiving or reading incoming faxes is not supported.
negative.prompt: Check my incoming faxes and read them to me.

de-DE.subtitle: Echte Faxe direkt aus dem Chat
de-DE.description:
mcpfax sendet echte Faxe an Faxnummern weltweit, direkt aus dem Gespräch. Geben Sie ChatGPT ein Dokument oder einen Text und eine Faxnummer: Der Assistent zeigt zuerst eine Vorschau, fragt nach Ihrer Bestätigung und sendet erst dann.

Das können Sie tun:
- Vorschau vor dem Versand (Nummernprüfung, Seitenzahl, Betrag)
- Fax senden (Text, hochgeladene Datei oder PDF über einen privaten Upload-Link), optional mit Deckblatt
- Fax für später planen und bis zum Versand stornieren
- Zustellstatus prüfen, Faxverlauf ansehen, Fax erneut senden
- Adressbuch für Faxempfänger führen
- Kontostand abfragen

Anmeldung per OAuth. Nur Versand: mcpfax kann keine Faxe empfangen und darf nicht für unerwünschte Werbefaxe verwendet werden.

Betreiber: PIT Webservices GmbH (Österreich). Support: support@mcpfax.de
